lastMessage.text: **Gate check complete.** Replace the north battery, then check the others next month.

bots.name: Ranch hand
bots.description: Weekly plans, shared reminders, and practical help around the house.
bots.instructions: Help our household plan the week. Keep replies concise and explain what needs a decision. Before changing shared plans, ask for confirmation. Use the connected calendar only when someone asks you to schedule a task.

entries.text: Trash and recycling go out Sunday night. Pickup is Monday morning.
Send weekly plans as a short checklist, with decisions first.

Garden watering: the drip timer runs at 6 a.m. Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Skip a cycle after more than half an inch of rain, and check the east bed by hand during heat advisories because its emitter clogs.
School pickup is 3:15 p.m. on weekdays.
